entries.zh: 使忧郁者欢乐；乐得忘却忧愁（乐以忘忧）
entries.en: to cheer the melancholic person; delight so as to forget one's cares

entries.zh: 放心；宽心，使心安无挂虑
entries.en: to put one's heart at ease, reassure; to gladden and ease the heart

entries.zh: 喜气；欢庆之气色、喜庆气氛
entries.en: joyful air, festive cheer; signs of joy
joyful countenance; cheer showing in the face

entries.zh: 喜颜；喜形于色，喜色显露在脸上
entries.en: joy that shows on the face; beaming countenance
entries.notes: 西语词头中 q̄ 为手稿缩写，按 17 世纪惯例展开为 que（alegría que sale a la cara），展开系推断。

entries.zh: 喜事；喜庆之事（婚嫁、吉庆等）
entries.en: joyful event, festive occasion; happy matter (wedding, celebration)

entries.zh: 喜幸；欢喜庆幸，心满意足
entries.en: joy and contentment; feeling consoled, fortunate

entries.zh: 心头开；开怀，心中舒畅欢喜
entries.en: to rejoice; one's heart opens and is gladdened

entries.zh: 清畅；性情爽朗舒畅，天然欢畅
爽快；爽朗快活，性格欢畅
entries.en: cheerful, lively; of a brisk festive disposition

entries.zh: 笑面；面常带笑，笑脸迎人
entries.en: smiling face; ever-cheerful, given to smiling

entries.zh: 笑呾；爱笑爱说，谈笑不休
entries.en: given to laughter and talk; ever-smiling, chatty
entries.notes: 呾为闽南语'说'字，官话无对应读音，R 栏系近音记写，故附此说明。

entries.zh: 作乐；行乐取乐，说笑奏乐自娱
entries.en: to make merry, amuse oneself; merry talk and music-making
joy and contentment; carefree ease, invigorating delight
awl; drill, boring tool (Sp. alezna, archaic for awl)

entries.zh: 武士；武官、军人（对应西语军衔 alferez）
entries.en: military man, man-at-arms; alferez (ensign, army officer)
entries.notes: 词头 A. lferek 依同页 position 19 的完整词形 alferek 展开为 alferez（alférez），缩写展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 旗手；掌旗官，执大旗之军官（alferez）
entries.en: standard-bearer, ensign (alferez); officer who carries the company's great flag
entries.notes: 词头后附闽南语 tŏa quy 即'大旗'，与旗手义互证。
